scenarios.name: CATEGORY-SIMPLIFICATION — caller unprompted mentions DVA, agent proceeds gracefully without a DVA-specific question

history.content: Hi, I'm a DVA patient, I'd like to book an appointment.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does NOT ask a DVA-specific question, does NOT say DVA is unavailable, and does NOT get stuck or loop. It proceeds exactly like any other booking request -- asks the LOCATION GATE question ("Are you coming to Raymond Terrace or Tea Gardens?"). The word DVA is matched to STANDARD in the CATEGORY TABLE and produces no special handling.

scenarios.name: ELISA-LOCATION-LOCK — caller asks if Elisa has an appointment tomorrow, agent must not misread this as a lookup of the caller's own booking

history.content: I was wondering if Elisa might have an appointment for tomorrow.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Agent does NOT call universal_router intent="details" and does NOT say anything like "you don't have any upcoming appointments" -- the caller is asking whether practitioner Elisa has availability, not checking their own booking record. PRACTITIONER-ONLY PATH / ELISA LOCATION LOCK fires instead: practitioner_preference is Elisa Brownhill, location is silently set to Raymond Terrace with zero acknowledgement of it, and the agent asks only the VARIANT_SELF question ("Have you been to Raymond Terrace and Tea Gardens Osteopaths before?"). Zero tool calls this turn.
